candidate_generation.universe: all 2^29 parity classes of the frozen current M29 basis

claim_boundary: The candidate generator reads no new pilot-search outcome and calls no point search.
The source M29 ledger is used only for the current curve/lattice and to exclude repeated base points.
The signed-basis distortion minimum is a calibration statistic, not a certified global height bound.
The 256-seed local-maxima sample is not a complete enumeration of M29/2M29.
The selected charts form a bounded mechanism pilot, not a rank, saturation, or point-absence test.

search_budget.checkpointing: one immutable result record after every chart

selection.primary_score: signed-basis visibility count, then estimated old-point exclusion margin 2D+min(delta)-log(B)
selection.secondary_selection: maximin current-lattice torus distance inside the top compression shortlist
